title: Rigid vessel
hints: Ask which variable the vessel fixes.
Use the first law with zero work.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: At fixed volume, $\Delta V=0$, so $w=0$ and $q_v=\Delta E$.
statement:
A rigid bomb calorimeter measures the heat of combustion at constant volume. What reaction quantity is directly related to the heat, assuming no other work?

[_]{a}

explanations: Heat equals enthalpy change under the constant-pressure conditions.
The heat need not vanish when work is zero.
